draft.shortGloss: to catch; to hold; to touch; to arrest
draft.emotion: quick and decisive, reaching out to secure something moving
notes: Often means simply 'to touch' with the hand, especially in warnings like ห้ามจับ ('Do not touch').
Used in many everyday compounds, such as จับมือ ('to hold hands' or 'to shake hands') and จับคู่ ('to pair up / match').

senses.definition: To take hold of, grip, or touch something with your hand.

examples.text: เธอจับมือฉันแน่นตอนเดินข้ามถนน

examples.emotion: protective and reassuring, holding on firmly

senses.definition: To capture or stop a moving object or animal.

examples.text: เขารีบวิ่งไปจับลูกบอล
examples.translation: He quickly ran to catch the ball.

senses.definition: To take someone into custody by legal authority.
